declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (verifier : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleVerifier Digest)
  (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinPolicySnapshot.PolicyDigestScheme)
  (state : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.FenceAuthorityState Digest scheme)
  (command : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.AuthorityCommand verifier scheme)
  (committable :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.CanCommitAuthorityCommand verifier scheme state
      command),
  ∃ receipt,
    (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.commitAuthorityCommand verifier scheme state command
            committable).receiptLedger =
        receipt :: state.receiptLedger ∧
      receipt.term = state.term ∧
        receipt.leaderId = state.leaderId ∧
          receipt.observedFence = ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.jointFence state.joint ∧
            receipt.committedFence =
              ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.jointFence
                (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.commitAuthorityCommand verifier scheme
                    state command committable).joint
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.authority_commit_records_bound_durable_receipt

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (verifier : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleVerifier Digest)
  (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinPolicySnapshot.PolicyDigestScheme)
  (state : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.FenceAuthorityState Digest scheme)
  (oldCommand : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.AuthorityCommand verifier scheme)
  (newLeader : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.LeaderId),
  oldCommand.term = state.term →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.CanCommitAuthorityCommand verifier scheme
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.electLeader state newLeader) oldCommand

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (verifier : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleVerifier Digest)
  (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinPolicySnapshot.PolicyDigestScheme)
  (state : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.FenceAuthorityState Digest scheme)
  (command : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.AuthorityCommand verifier scheme)
  (committable :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.CanCommitAuthorityCommand verifier scheme state
      command),
  ∃ receipt,
    receipt ∈
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.commitAuthorityCommand verifier scheme state
            command committable).receiptLedger ∧
      receipt.observedFence = ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointFence.jointFence state.joint

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (verifier : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleVerifier Digest)
  (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinPolicySnapshot.PolicyDigestScheme)
  (state : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.FenceAuthorityState Digest scheme)
  (command : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.AuthorityCommand verifier scheme)
  (committable :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.CanCommitAuthorityCommand verifier scheme state command)
  (existing : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.FenceCommitReceipt scheme.Digest),

      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinFenceAuthority.commitAuthorityCommand verifier scheme state command
          committable).receiptLedger
